facts.fact: Rebecca Cook 急着回家做晚饭，已经迟了一小时。
facts.anchor: Rebecca Cook was desperate to get home to start dinner. She was supposed to be there an hour ago.

facts.fact: 她四十多岁，两岁女儿在后座睡着，而且有点微醺（她从不承认）。
facts.anchor: She was in her forties, mother to a two-year-old daughter, currently asleep in the back seat, and she was—though she’d never admit it—a little buzzed.

facts.fact: 去杂货店路上停下来见好友 April Gallagher 喝「咖啡」——下午两点后那就是酒，一杯变成了一瓶。
facts.anchor: she’d stopped to meet her best friend, April Gallagher, for “coffee.” Except, past 2 p.m., that meant wine. And a glass had turned into a bottle.

facts.fact: 她丈夫参与了新修双车道公路建设，通勤时间缩短一半以上。
facts.anchor: her husband had played a big part in putting in the new two-lane highway—which cut travel time more than in half

facts.fact: 她猛打方向，差点撞上站在车前翼子板旁抬手挡光的男人。
facts.anchor: barely avoiding the man standing at the front fender of the car, hands raised against the blinding light as though he was waving to get her attention

facts.fact: 女儿惊醒大哭但没受伤。
facts.anchor: looking back at her daughter, now awake—startled and wide-eyed, but unharmed

facts.fact: 她下车找人——男人不见了，只剩他那辆车无声停在道上。
facts.anchor: But there was no sign of him. Just his car, parked silent and dark in the roadway.

facts.fact: 女儿哭声盖住了从她背后逼近的脚步声。
facts.anchor: Covering the sound of the footsteps coming up behind her.
